summary: Faz B Etkinlik Galerisi (Event Gallery) full-stack test. Backend pytest 9/9 PASS: studio-authenticated events CRUD, chunked upload (JPEG produces thumb, RAW .nef flagged is_raw + warning, no thumb), event detail with photos, service-packs create/list/delete, public GET /gallery/public/{token} returns event+photos+packs+firma, STRICT album_limit enforcement (400 with detail 'Albüm limiti 2. 3 seçtiniz.'), successful submit returns SIP-*, resubmit rejected (400 'zaten gönderilmiş'), studio order visible with album_count=2, status pipeline new→processing (invalid rejected 400), PDF stream returns application/pdf %PDF header. Regression /api/services + /api/design/fonts OK. Frontend E2E via Playwright: studio login → /studyo/panel → 'Etkinlik Galerisi' card links to /studyo/galeri → tabs sg-tab-events/packs/orders switch → sg-new-event-btn dialog creates event (album_limit=2) → sg-event-card renders → sg-copy-link copies /galeri/<token> URL to clipboard (verified via clipboard.readText) → sg-open opens EventDetail → sg-upload-input uploads 3 JPGs + 1 .nef via chunked upload; 4 sg-photo-* rendered, RAW badge visible on nef; sg-del-photo works → sg-tab-packs creates TEST_UI_Pack (199₺). Public /galeri/{token} in fresh context: header shows firma 'Test Stüdyo' + event name, 3 non-raw + 1 raw photo, toggling gs-toggle-album on 3 photos with limit=2 CORRECTLY BLOCKS 3rd toggle client-side with toast (2 remain on), gs-pack- upsell checkbox works, gs-note filled, gs-submit → gs-success shows 'Seçiminiz alındı! Sipariş No: SIP-A62426'. Revisit → 'Seçiminiz zaten alındı'. Back in studio orders tab (AFTER page reload) order shows 'SIP-A62426 · TEST_UI_Event · Albüm 2 · Kanvas 1 · Retouch 1 · Upsell 500₺'; sg-order-status-* dropdown → Hazırlanıyor toast 'Durum güncellendi'; sg-order-pdf-* downloads siparis-SIP-*.pdf (1998 bytes, %PDF header). Regression: /studyo/panel renders studio-limit-design, / loads, /tasarim-studyosu renders ds-add-personalize.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText is not wrapped in try/catch. In sandboxed/preview iframes or when permission is denied, the unhandled NotAllowedError bubbles up and triggers webpack-dev-server-client-overlay 'Uncaught runtime errors: Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied.' which overlays the ENTIRE page and blocks all subsequent clicks. Reproducible on fresh browser context without clipboard permission. Fix: wrap in try/catch or use .catch(() => toast.error('Kopyalanamadı, link: ...')) and also show the link inline as fallback.

integration_issues.issue: StudioGallery only fetches loadEvents/loadPacks/loadOrders on component mount (useEffect empty deps). Clicking sg-tab-orders after a public client submit does NOT refetch — the new order does not appear until the user hard-reloads the page. Similarly Packs/Events tabs never refresh with server state during the session. Fix: call the appropriate load function in each tab click handler (or add a manual refresh button, or poll).

action_items: Fix copyLink clipboard error: wrap navigator.clipboard.writeText in try/catch, show link as toast fallback so failure does not crash the app via webpack overlay.
Add tab-switch refetch (or polling) in StudioGallery so newly-submitted orders show up in the Orders tab without a full page reload.
critical_code_review_comments: gallery.py update_order_status: does an EXTRA find_one to resolve event_id AFTER the update_one — a race window where order can be deleted between calls (`(await find_one(...))['event_id']` will KeyError). Fetch order first, then update, and reuse the event_id from that fetch.

gallery.py _UPLOADS is an in-memory dict — will NOT survive backend restarts and does not scale to multiple workers. Acceptable for preview but must be moved to Redis / GridFS / temp files for prod. Also there is NO garbage collection for abandoned upload sessions (memory leak).
gallery.py upload_init/chunk/complete has no size cap. A malicious studio could OOM the process by declaring a huge total_chunks and streaming chunks. Add max_size and max_total_chunks guards.

public_select does not verify that the payload.selections photo_ids actually belong to the event before counting/updating — attacker could send arbitrary photo_ids to inflate album count. Filter by event_id in the count too (currently album_n counts every entry, even if photo_id is invalid). Also the update `update_one({'id': s.photo_id, 'event_id': ev['id']})` silently no-ops for foreign ids; but the counter still counts them.
delete_event does not delete the underlying photo blobs from storage (put_object files remain orphaned). Add loop to call a delete_object.

GallerySelect.jsx toggle limit check uses `current >= limit` before flipping. Works but does not stop turning OFF (fine) and does not block a batch of already-selected photos when the limit is lowered mid-session (edge case).
StudioGallery.jsx window.confirm for delete event is an anti-pattern vs shadcn AlertDialog.
gallery.py public /gallery/public/{token} returns full studio_id inside photos array — minor info leak; strip studio_id / event_id when serving to public.

Order PDF _build_order_pdf uses ASCII-only titles ('Siparis', 'Album', 'Musteri') because Helvetica cannot render Turkish diacritics — content is intentionally transliterated. Should switch to a TTF (DejaVu/Noto) so 'Sipariş / Albüm / Müşteri' render correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 95% — all E2E flows worked; 2 integration bugs found (clipboard crash + missing tab refetch)

seed_data_creation: During the run: 1 TEST_UI_Event_* event with 3 jpg + 1 nef photos, 1 TEST_UI_Pack_* upsell pack, 1 SIP-* order via public submit. All TEST_UI_* events & packs cleaned up at end of test. The generated SIP-* order remains (order documents are not deleted individually, but its event was deleted which also removes the order via delete_event cascade).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two frontend fixes are pending: (1) StudioGallery.jsx copyLink must swallow clipboard errors, (2) tab click handlers in StudioGallery must call loadEvents/loadPacks/loadOrders. Backend Faz B is fully solid. During Playwright testing you MUST call context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write'], origin=BASE_URL) BEFORE clicking sg-copy-link-*, otherwise the webpack-dev-server-client-overlay will hijack the page. To exercise Orders tab after a public submit, either reload the page OR trigger a status change (which internally calls reload). Existing seeded token PP6nmfQL7S7U (Demo Nişan Galerisi album_limit=3) may already be submitted from earlier iterations — always create your own event for public-select regression.
rca of the issue: copyLink crash: React does not swallow rejected promises returned from event handlers when webpack dev-server has the error overlay client active — navigator.clipboard.writeText returns a Promise that rejects with NotAllowedError under sandboxed contexts, and because copyLink is not await/try-catch wrapped the rejection surfaces via window.onunhandledrejection into the overlay iframe (visible in screenshot with red 'Uncaught runtime errors' block). Simple .catch fix resolves it. Orders tab stale: tab state is only local UI state; the three load functions are invoked once on mount and after mutating actions inside their own tab (create pack / delete event / status change). Public submit happens out-of-band, so orders array never receives the new item until next mount.
